lead.question: 逃学的孩子大多缺乏想象力，可这个男孩为何反倒成了纪录保持者？
lead.warmup: 同样是逃学，多数孩子至多安静钓一天鱼，或在电影院里把同一部影片看上八小时。可本课的小主人公一路搭便车，钻进船里睡了一觉，醒来时竟已漂到加来；又坐卡车到了巴黎，被下一辆车带到法西边境的佩皮尼昂。逃学逃出国境，结局却不浪漫——他被警察抓住，遣送回英国。
goals: 复述男孩从多佛经加来、巴黎到佩皮尼昂的逃学路线与最终结局
掌握 play truant、put ... to shame、in the meantime、as far as、creep off、evade 等核心表达
辨析 who、while、when、as 引导的从句以及 and、but 构成的并列句
仿写现在分词作状语的句子，如 while playing truant
lead.summary: 本课记述一个逃学男孩无意中旅行一千六百英里的经历：搭便车到多佛，钻进船里过夜，醒来发现船已开到加来，趁无人注意爬下船，又搭卡车到巴黎，最后被带到法西边境的佩皮尼昂，被警察截获后遣送回英国。
lead.tips: put ... to shame（使……相形见绌）不等于 be ashamed of（为……感到羞耻）。

questions.q: Did the boy go where he wanted to?
questions.zh: 男孩去了他想去的地方吗？
questions.a: No, he didn't. The next car did not take him into the centre of Paris as he hoped it would, but to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border, where a policeman picked him up and the local authorities sent him back to England.
questions.aZh: 没有。他本来想去巴黎市中心，却被带到了法西边境的佩皮尼昂；他在那里被警察抓住，由当地当局送回了英国。

questions.q: 作者为什么说逃学的孩子 unimaginative？他们通常的“极限”是什么？
questions.zh: 为什么说逃学的孩子缺乏想象力？
questions.a: Because a quiet day's fishing, or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again, is usually as far as they get — truants never go beyond that.
questions.aZh: 因为他们最了不起的“壮举”也不过是安静地钓一天鱼，或在电影院里把同一部影片反复看上八小时。

questions.q: How did the boy cross the Channel without knowing it?
questions.zh: 男孩如何在不知情的情况下渡过英吉利海峡？
questions.a: He hitchhiked to Dover and, towards evening, went into a boat to find somewhere to sleep. When he woke up next morning, the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais, and no one noticed him as he crept off.
questions.aZh: 他搭便车到了多佛，天快黑时钻进一条船里找地方睡觉；早上醒来时船已开到加来，他爬下船时谁也没有发现他。
questions.hint: 见第 4-6 句，注意 in the meantime 与 crept off。

questions.q: How did the lorry driver treat him, and why was he finally sent back to England?
questions.zh: 卡车司机怎样对待他？他为何最终被送回英国？
questions.a: The driver gave him a few biscuits and a cup of coffee and left him just outside the city; the next car took him to Perpignan, where a policeman picked him up and the local authorities sent him back to England.
questions.aZh: 司机给了他几块饼干和一杯咖啡，把他留在城外；下一辆车把他带到佩皮尼昂，他在那里被警察抓住并遣送回英国。
questions.hint: 见第 8-10 句，pick up 此处意为“逮捕”。

questions.q: Was the boy really more imaginative than other truants? Why does the writer call him a record-holder?
questions.zh: 他真的比其他逃学者更有想象力吗？为什么称他为纪录保持者？
questions.a: Hardly by design: he only wanted somewhere to sleep and was carried abroad by chance. The writer calls him a record-holder humorously — by accident he travelled much further than any unimaginative truant, putting them all to shame.
questions.aZh: 很难说是刻意为之：他只是想找个地方睡觉，却阴差阳错被船带出了国。作者幽默地称他为纪录保持者——他无意中走得比任何逃学者都远。
questions.hint: 结合标题、unimaginative、put to shame 与 set up a record。

exercises.q: 词汇填空：Many children dream of ______ (evade) school, and some of them even play ______ from it every week.
exercises.note: dream of 后接动名词；play truant 逃学。

exercises.q: 用现在分词短语改写：While he was playing truant, the boy travelled 1,600 miles.
exercises.a: While playing truant, the boy travelled 1,600 miles.
exercises.note: 主从句主语一致可省略。

exercises.q: 写出 unimaginative 的反义词，并用它翻译：画家应当富于想像力。
用 put ... to shame 改写：His 1,600-mile journey made all other truants look ordinary.
exercises.a: His 1,600-mile journey put all other truants to shame.
exercises.note: put ... to shame 使……相形见绌。

exercises.q: 同义替换：When he woke up next morning, he discovered that the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais.
exercises.a: Meanwhile, the boat had travelled to Calais.

exercises.q: 连词填空：The next car the boy stopped did not take him into the centre of Paris ______ he hoped it would, ______ to Perpignan.
exercises.note: as 引导方式状语从句，but 连接并列状语。

exercises.q: 中译英：第二天早上他醒来时发现船已经到了加来，他趁没人注意爬下船，又搭上一辆卡车去了巴黎。
exercises.a: When he woke up next morning, he discovered that the boat had travelled to Calais. No one noticed him as he crept off, and he hitchhiked to Paris in a lorry.
exercises.note: creep off 爬离；hitchhike 搭便车。

quiz.q: 标题中的 “the record-holder” 指的是谁？
options: The boy who travelled 1,600 miles while playing truant
The lorry driver who gave him biscuits and coffee
The policeman who picked him up
The child who watched the same film eight hours
quiz.note: 指逃学旅行 1,600 英里的男孩。

quiz.q: “Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.” 中 play truant 的意思是：
options: Stay away from school without permission
Play games in the playground
Travel abroad during the holidays
Sit quietly fishing for a whole day

quiz.q: 课文中 “that is usually as far as they get” 里的 as far as 表示：
options: To the greatest degree they can ever reach
To a place very far away
As long as the day is quiet
Until the same film is over

quiz.q: “The boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais.” 中 in the meantime 可替换为：
options: meanwhile
in the end
as far as
over and over again

quiz.q: 选择正确形式填空：No one noticed the boy as he ______ off.
options: creeped
crept
was creep
has creeping

quiz.q: 男孩最终没能进入巴黎市中心，原因是：
options: The boat took him straight back to England
The next car took him to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border
The lorry driver left him inside the city
He gave up and went back to school
